verdict.rationale: Bento supports outbound webhooks as a workflow action ('Send webhook') that notifies external systems when a workflow reaches a certain point, which can be triggered by events like purchases, tags, or behaviors, but the evidence never documents specific engagement events (opens, clicks, bounces, unsubscribes) as native webhook triggers, nor any signed-payload/signature-verification mechanism. missing for 10: documented event catalog (sends/opens/clicks/bounces/unsubscribes) as webhook triggers, payload signing/verification scheme, independent confirmation of reliability.
